summary: TutelApp iteration 6 — FRONTEND ONLY (backend not re-tested per request). All 6 requested flows validated on the Expo web preview at https://salute-naviga.preview.emergentagent.com with a 390×844 mobile viewport. (1) STORICO VALUTAZIONI: after completing the wizard (Io stesso → Meno di 30 giorni fa → Dipendente Privato → Sì → warn-continue-btn) and tapping results-home-btn, the home shows 'LE TUE VALUTAZIONI' (home-history) with one home-history-item-* row ('Io stesso · Dipendente Privato · 25 agosto 2026') that on tap correctly reopens the same results page. Before any assessment is completed home-history is NOT rendered — correct. (2) POST-REFACTOR RESULTS: for work='Dipendente Privato' the three colored right sections are all present (results-section-permessi, results-section-sede, results-section-fiscali). DeadlineCard (results-deadline): typing 15062026 into deadline-date-input is autoSlashed to '15/06/2026' and pressing deadline-save-btn produces deadline-days-left = 'Mancano 19 giorni' (verified from 25/08/2026 today). AssistantCard (results-assistant): tapping assistant-suggestion-0 returns an Italian AI answer via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in ~4-6s, 1280 chars, starting with '# Permessi Legge 104 per te stesso 👋 Capisco che sia un momento delicato…'. appeal-toggle expands appeal-body correctly. results-share-btn opens the ShareModal with share-qr visible and share-close-btn closes it. results-pdf-btn is present. (3) REGIONAL BANNER + TRANSPORT CONTACTS: setting region to Sicilia on Home → banner practical-help-region reads 'Servizi per la tua regione: Sicilia' + portal link 'Regione Siciliana — Salute ↗' (practical-help-portal-link) visible; opening help-card-toggle-trasporto shows body 'In Sicilia cerca la Pubblica Assistenza (rete ANPAS — anpas.org)…' (ANPAS present, NO 'Sarzana'). Switching region back to Liguria and reopening the same assessment shows 'Contatti locali: Pubblica Assistenza Sarzana — Via Falcinello 2, tel. 0187 620200…' (Sarzana present). (4) VAULT + GUIDE: setting localStorage['salutenav:vaultUnlocked']='"1"' + reload shows vault-unlocked box. Tapping practical-help-guide-btn (with window.print stubbed to a no-op on web) appends {name:'Guida_Servizi_Sociali_Liguria.pdf'} to localStorage['salutenav:vaultFiles'] and vault-file-0 renders 'Guida_Servizi_Sociali_Liguria.pdf 25/08/2026'. vault-save-report-btn prepends {name:'Report_TutelApp_25-08-2026.pdf'} and vault-file-delete-0 removes the file (LS goes back to only the guide entry). (5) STRIPE CHECKOUT REGRESSION: removing salutenav:vaultUnlocked + reload, tapping vault-cta triggers POST /api/payments/checkout → 200 and the page navigates to https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_a1N6sTCAyIDFpfUtODUA3kxoziLzqog6hANdX1EJRrar362S3C9iYCGaVJ (verified via route intercept + framenavigated; navigation aborted before completion as requested). (6) HOME: fully scrollable (ScrollView), TutelApp logo + wordmark + LA TUA REGIONE card + Inizia il percorso + 4-step indicator + LE TUE VALUTAZIONI (once populated) + coffee support box all render with no glitches. Only console warnings observed are the standard react-native-web '"shadow*" style props are deprecated' notice — non-blocking. No red-screen errors.
critical_code_review_comments: risultati/[id].tsx correctly slimmed to ~400 lines after extracting AssistantCard/ShareModal/AppealSection/RightsSectionCard and centralising vault logic in src/lib/vault.ts — good refactor, well under the 700-line soft cap.

PracticalHelpSection.downloadGuide() uses Platform.OS==='web' to call Print.printAsync then addVaultFile only when isVaultUnlocked() — correct, and confirmed at runtime: the file only lands in the vault when the vault is unlocked.

storage wrapper stores JSON.stringify-ed values on web, so the unlock flag lives as '"1"' in localStorage['salutenav:vaultUnlocked']; isVaultUnlocked() compares against '1' after storage.getItem parses it — behaviour is consistent, verified end-to-end.

transportContacts(regione) hard-codes only the Liguria/Sarzana contact and falls back to a generic ANPAS/CRI hint for every other region — as designed, verified working. Consider expanding per-region contacts in a follow-up (Lombardia, Lazio, Campania, etc.).
Persistent (non-blocking) react-native-web console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — same as iteration 5, can be migrated when convenient.

seed_data_creation: None — one payment_transactions row was created server-side by the vault-cta Stripe checkout test (deviceId from the test browser session; not cleaned up server-side, but harmless as payment_status remains 'pending' and no card was completed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The DeadlineCard input is a masked TextInput with autoSlash: type raw digits (e.g. '15062026') via page.keyboard.type — do NOT use fill('2026-06-15'), it will render as '20/26/0615' and produce a 'formato non valido' error. To exercise the vault-unlocked flow on web, set localStorage.setItem('salutenav:vaultUnlocked', JSON.stringify('1')) and reload (the storage util JSON-parses values, so the unlock value must itself be a JSON string). window.print is called by PracticalHelpSection.downloadGuide on web — stub it with page.evaluate("() => { window.print = () => {}; }") right before clicking practical-help-guide-btn to keep the automation moving; the vault file is added independently of the print dialog. To validate the Stripe checkout without leaving the app, register page.route('**/*', ...) and abort requests whose URL contains 'checkout.stripe.com'; use page.on('framenavigated') to observe the intended target URL. Wizard step-2/3 options require scrollIntoView({block:'center'}) before clicking because the fixed footer 'Avanti' button (wizard-next-btn) overlaps below-fold options. All backend tests (27/27) already validated in iteration 5 — do not re-run unless backend files change.
